 Introducing Call of Duty: Mobile Season 10 — 7th Anniversary
 November 04, 2026
 by Call of Duty Staff
 CODM
 News
 Announcements
 Call of Duty: Mobile Season 10 — 7th Anniversary
 A New Era of Battle Royale on Verdansk 
 New LTM: Create Your Truth 
 Verdansk Livestream 
 Verdansk in DMZ: Recon 
 New Seasonal & Ford Events 
 7th Anniversary Battle Pass 
 Store Update: Two New Mythics, Ford Racing Draws 
 November 04, 2026
 by Call of Duty Staff
 Play Now 
 Celebrate the 7th Anniversary with a massive update delivering a new era of Battle Royale with the arrival of Verdansk. Get details on the new map plus new gameplay mechanics being introduced to both big maps. Earn free rewards across a feast of events, and look out for two new Mythic Drops, including a Mythic Weapon and a Mythic Operator. Grab some Legendary vehicles in the Ford Racing collaboration Draws alongside a free themed event. Season 10 arrives November 11 at 4PM PT.
 FREE DAILY GIFT
 A NEW GIFT EVERY DAY ON THE WEB STORE
 Get Gift 
 A new era of Battle Royale is coming to Call of Duty®: Mobile in Season 10 with the arrival of Verdansk, a massive new map with 15+ major points of interest. New gameplay, movement, and other changes that will affect both big maps are coming, too, introducing a new feel and a fresh set of tactical opportunities to help you survive. As a bonus, Verdansk is also coming to DMZ: Recon alongside a new boss and contract.
 Celebrate the 7 th Anniversary of Call of Duty: Mobile with many events throughout the season, including a story-based event in Verdansk featuring a Ghost Operator Skin and Legendary Assault Rifle Blueprint as rewards. In the Store, look forward to two new Mythic Drops, and get additional rewards in the Battle Pass, including the new Signal 50 Sniper Rifle and more.
 Season 10 — 7 th Anniversary launches on November 11 at 4PM PT.

 A New Era of Battle Royale Begins on Verdansk
 Season 10 marks a huge update for Battle Royale, bringing a new big map plus changes to the UI, gameplay mechanics, movement, and more, including:
 New animations for 3 rd person view on Verdansk and in DMZ
 Updated movement and airborne controls
 Parachutes can be deployed in-match in Verdansk, replacing wingsuits
 Doors can be shoulder bashed open if you run through them
 Players can now drag downed teammates while reviving them
 Take on in-game contracts for rewards
 Updated UI and lobby scenes
 Future Battle Royale updates are scheduled to include more gameplay improvements, including adjustments to vehicles, movement, and the overall mode as the Battle Royale experience continues into a new era of a gameplay.
 Field Assets 
 Starting in Season 10, Scorestreaks in Battle Royale will be renamed Field Assets, which can now be equipped to Loadouts and will generally be less common throughout your Battle Royale matches to make them rarer, more valuable, and more powerful. Field Assets can be purchased at Buy Stations, though we’ve made some changes to their cost.
 Additionally, wield a new scope mechanism when activating Field Assets like the Strafing Run and Stealth Chopper, and get your hands on new Field Assets including the Death Machine and EMP Systems.
 Perks 
 Similar to Field Assets, we’ve renamed Wildcards to Perks just for Battle Royale and you can now find them in matches or equip them to your Loadout, allowing you to access them via Loadout Drops and the Buy Station. Here is a list of the available Perks in Battle Royale:
 Wild Hip Fire​ 
 Greatly increases hip-fire accuracy; after hitting an enemy, further increases hip-fire accuracy for a short time.​
 Tracking Ammo​ 
 Greatly reduces bullet spread during ADS; after hitting an enemy, marks them for a short time. Cooldown: 30 seconds.​
 Slide Reload​ 
 Greatly increases bullet spread density; increases slide speed; while sliding, grants an additional accuracy bonus and reloads one bullet.​
 Flinch Reduction / Toughness​ 
 Greatly suppresses vertical recoil and flinch.​
 Void Reload / Reserve Reload​ 
 Greatly increases magazine capacity; periodically reloads one weapon from the backpack.​
 Precise Shot / Long Shot​ 
 Greatly increases range and damage on precision hits.​
 Fast ADS​ 
 Greatly increases ADS speed and provides a brief movement-speed boost after exiting ADS​
 ADS Movement Speed​ 
 Greatly reduces lateral recoil and increases ADS movement speed.​
 Sniper Expert​ 
 Greatly suppresses breathing sway and allows semi-automatic sniper rifles to fire continuously.​
 Ballistic Calibration​ 
 Greatly increases bullet muzzle velocity; when your own health is low, further suppresses recoil and flinch (upward kick when hit).​
 Hunter's Rhythm​ 
 Increases ammo capacity, and for a short time after a kill, greatly reduces ADS delay.​
 Advancing Suppression​ 
 Triggered while moving: Reduces hip-fire spread and ADS spread while moving.​
 Reload Rush​ 
 Greatly increases reload speed; for a short time after reloading, increases movement speed.​
 Sustained Fire Correction​ 
 Greatly speeds up recoil recovery and reduces the spread buildup from sustained fire; the maximum recoil buildup cap tightens further during continuous firing.​
 Welcome to Verdansk 
 The iconic Battle Royale map is officially coming to Call of Duty: Mobile . Explore 15+ major points of interest (POI) across Verdansk, a massive Battle Royale map with locations supporting every style of gameplay.
 On Verdansk, every POI feels unique and highly detailed, offering plenty of ways to advance, hide from enemies, set up ambushes, snipe from afar, and any other tactic to annihilate enemy squads and stay alive until the end. The major POIs you’ll encounter include:
 Superstore 
 Airport 
 Storage Town 
 Dam 
 Scrapyard 
 Train Station 
 TV Station 
 Promenade 
 Hospital 
 Downtown 
 Park 
 Port 
 Prison 
 Farmland 
 Stadium 
 Lumber 
 Quarry 
 Military Base 
 Previous 
 Next 
 For a deeper look at the map and to get ready for launch, keep an eye out for the Verdansk interactive map guide detailing all the main points of interest alongside important features like Buy Stations and vehicle placement. The map guide will go live on November 5.
 Fight For Your Life in the Gulag 
 In Verdansk, the first time you’re eliminated in the match, you will be relocated to the Gulag to fight for your chance to reenter the match. Join the other spectators as you wait for your turn to fight and then give it all you have to beat the other player. Win and you’ll redeploy into Verdansk. Lose and you’re out of the game until a teammate purchases your redeployment at a Buy Station.
 New LTM: Create Your Truth
 Learn the Ropes of Verdansk 
 Drop into Verdansk in a narrative experience tasking you to collect map codes, decode intel, find NPCs, and follow HUD guidance to the Stadium. The limited-time playlist features infinite respawns and introduces important elements of the game. Complete the mission to unlock rewards including the Calling Card — Verdansk Inbound and an Epic Frame and Avatar.
 Watch the Verdansk Livestream, Get Rewards
 Watch the Verdansk Livestream on November 4 starting at 11:30AM PT on YouTube and TikTok to get a detailed look at everything related to Verdansk and the Battle Royale updates coming in Season 10. Watch the stream in-game to earn rewards, including the Price — Verdansk Expert Operator Skin*.
 Verdansk in DMZ: Recon and More
 Verdansk is also coming to DMZ: Recon in Season 10 along with a new boss and contract. Deploy with your squad, fight against player and non-player enemies throughout the map, and earn rewards for taking on the following challenges:
 New Chemist Boss: The Chemist takes up residence in the radiation zone, bringing elite bodyguards and a devastating personal arsenal including a grenade launcher, gas grenades, and deadly melee attack. Gear up and equip your Gas Mask before heading in. Defeat the chemist for the chance to earn a new Weapon Blueprint, Chemist Operator Skin, and other high-tier loot.
 Prison Highlight Contract: Gather your squad and head to the prison. In this high-stakes contract, you must give up your gear and become a prisoner. Search through the prison for items and seek out the warden’s key to find your way out.
 New Seasonal Events
 The 7 th Anniversary is packed with events, from Verdansk-themed events to normal and anniversary events, giving out some great free rewards. Highlights include: 
 Operation: Verdansk Convergence 
 Complete tasks and join one of three factions vying for supremacy in Verdansk: Makarov, Task Force 141, and the Observers. Take on objectives across multiple acts to dig into the narrative of Verdansk and earn milestone rewards including the Ghost — Desert Ghost Operator Skin and DLQ33 — Verdansk Event Sniper Rifle Blueprint, with the final reward offering the Legendary AK47 — Pharoah's Decree
 After completing all the tasks for one faction, you may join another, so that it’s possible to earn all rewards.
 Mail Call 
 Roll the dice and collect rewards as you move across the event board, encountering developer notes along the way celebrating Call of Duty: Mobile ’s 7 th Anniversary, including an Epic Kilo 141 Assault Rifle Weapon Blueprint and other anniversary themed rewards.
 New Ford Racing Collaboration Event 
 Ready Set Ford  
 A week after season launch, you’ll be able to experience the Ford Racing collaboration through this task-based event. Move through milestones by completing basic tasks like logging in, playing matches, and getting kills in any mode. This can earn you over 20 rewards, including the Urban Tracker — Pit Crew Operator Skin, Rallycar — Sports Mode Vehicle Skin, and the weapon DRH — Command Console Weapon Blueprint.
 7 th Anniversary Battle Pass: New Weapon 
 The 7 th Anniversary Battle Pass features free and premium in-game content including new Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, Calling Cards, and additional Call of Duty® Points to spend on your next Premium Pass or Store purchase.
 Battle Pass Free Tiers 
 Deal heavy damage against distant targets with the fast-firing Signal 50, a powerful weapon ideally suited for the long sightlines throughout Verdansk.  Other free tier rewards include additional Operator Skins, Weapons Blueprints, Vault Coins, and more.
 Premium Pass Tiers 
 The premium 7 th Anniversary Battle Pass gives access to an assortment of black and gold-themed Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, and more, including the chance to unlock a Weapon Blueprint for the new Signal 50.
 Premium Operator Skins include Naga — Trickster Royale, Velikan — Blackcell, Death Angel Alice — Midnight, and Keegan — Trap Master Royale. Dominate in Verdansk with Weapon Blueprints like the RAM-7 - Golden Shadow, KRM 262 — Regal Shot, Hades — Tartarus, and the Signal 50 — Nightfallen.
 Battle Pass Subscription: Enlist with the Ground Forces by purchasing a Battle Pass Subscription, granting additional monthly rewards along with a 10% boost to Player and Weapon XP, discount coupons, and limited discounts on 10x crate pulls.
 The Season 10 Ground Forces will receive the Pathfinder — Undaunted Blackcell Operator Skin, the Outlaw — Trickster's Royale Weapon Blueprint, and Backpack 1 — Trickster's Bag.
 Store Update: New Mythics, Draws
 New Mythics 
 Season 10 is celebrating the 7 th Anniversary in a big way by introducing two new Mythic Drops bringing both a Mythic Operator and Mythic Weapon Blueprint. Both Mythic offers come with the highest quality of customization options, including different operator variants, weapon kill effects and reticles, and many other Mythic Upgrade customizations.
 Means to an End Mythic Drop: The Mythic Alias — Shattered Effigy Operator Skin leads this Draw including other valuable rewards like the Legendary ICR-1 — Effigy Assault Rifle Weapon Blueprint, Spin Kick Emote, Calling Card — Alias Ascendant, and more.
 Botanist Mythic Drop: Wield the new Season 10 weapon with the Mythic Signal 50 — Exobotanica Sniper Rifle Weapon Blueprint, featuring a translucent sci-fi design with a visible plant sample housed within the weapon’s frame. Alongside this, you can acquire the Tempest — Exo Botanist Operator Skin, RAM-7 — Chlorophyll Bloom Assault Rifle Weapon Blueprint, Machete — Cultivator, and more.
 Lucky Draws 
 2026 World Champs Final Draw: Celebrate the Call of Duty: Mobile competitive spirit with this new Draw focused around the 2026 World Champs event. Grab rewards including the USS 9 — COD:M Champion SMG Legendary Weapon Blueprint, FFAR1 — 2026 World Champs Final Assault Rifle Epic Weapon Blueprint, Karambit — World Champs Finals Epic Weapon Blueprint, and more.
 Make your prediction on who will win the 2026 Call of Duty: Mobile World Championship through the related in-game event, Finale - Winner Takes All, to earn free rewards including discount coupons for the World Champs Final Draw.
 Ford Racing Collaboration Draws: During your deployments to Verdansk, you’ll encounter contracts rewarding you with one of two Ford Racing themed Vehicles, the Ford Mustang GTD and the F-150 Raptor, offering new ways to move through the map. Both Ford Racing Vehicles can be purchased at a Buy Station as well.
 Head to the Store after your match for the chance to get these Vehicles Skins alongside high-quality Operator Skin variants, weapon blueprints, and more across two new Ford Racing Lucky Draws.
 Ford Racing Table Tactics: For those looking to rev up their Scorestreaks, keep an eye out for the Ford Table Tactics offer dropping shortly after launch. This unique offer has two Legendary variants of the Shock RC Scorestreak, including one for the Ford Mustang GTD and one for the F-150 Raptor.
 Battle Pass Vaults: The Final Snow Battle Pass (2021) enters the Vault in Season 10. Get epic rewards you missed out on the first time such as Girasol — Clairvoyant; Synaptic Tranquility, FFAR 1 — Surrender, Koshka — Illusory Moon, Final Show, and Vagr Modir — Whisper of Winter.
 Season 10 — 7 th Anniversary launches on Call of Duty: Mobile on November 11 th at 4 PM PT.
 See you online.
